canonical_project: Second Afghanistan National Data Center in Nangarhar
owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology / Government of Afghanistan
notes: MCIT stated during the Ministry of Mines and Petroleum data-center/MCRS inauguration that it would create the second National Data Center in Nangarhar province; no capacity or completion evidence was found. Mordor's Afghanistan market report also identifies Jalalabad/rest-of-Afghanistan as a prospective edge traffic area, but without a named facility.
